name: proservices-barcode-suite
description: Shared ProServices QR/barcode scanning core with Scanner and Inventory/POS editions.

scripts.build:scanner: npm run edition:scanner && npm run build
scripts.build:pro: npm run edition:pro && npm run build
scripts.check: node --check src/app.js && node --check src/edition-config.js && node --check src/hardware-scanner.js && node --check src/inventory.js && node --check src/product-catalog.js && node --check src/result-actions.js && node --check src/scanner.js && node --check src/storage.js && node --check src/sales.js && node --check src/sales-page.js && node --check scripts/configure-edition.mjs && node --check scripts/dev-server.mjs && node --check sw.js
scripts.verify: npm run check && npm run check:app-shell && npm test && npm run build:pro
scripts.android:add: npm run build:pro && npx cap add android
scripts.android:sync: npm run build:pro && npx cap sync android
